name: Fresh Canna Live Resin | Skywalker OG
description: Take a trip to the stars with Fresh Canna’s Live Resin Wax – Skywalker OG, an out-of-this-world indica-dominant hybrid known for its heavy relaxation and bold flavor. Crafted from fresh-frozen cannabis, this live resin wax delivers a terp-rich, ultra-smooth dabbing experience with maximum potency. Expect earthy pine, spicy diesel, and a touch of citrus in every hit, followed by a deeply soothing body high that melts away stress, tension, and worries. Ideal for evening sessions, pain relief, and total relaxation, Skywalker OG is the perfect strain to help you drift off into a galaxy of pure bliss.
